name: farm-csa
description: Bramblecut Farm, a fictional five-person certified organic vegetable farm on 22 acres of Driftless hillside near Viroqua, Wisconsin. It sells a twenty-week CSA (the Stand Card, Half, Full and Kitchen shares, with pay-in-4 and sliding-scale options), runs an honor-box farm stand, and hosts four farm dinners a year at one long table in the squash field. The whole site is dressed as seed packets and produce crates, printed in two inks on kraft.
